Error handling: When a model fails on multiple files, the audit tool should either retry with exponential backoff or escalate to a different model rather than returning inconclusive
Cost optimization: The qwen model consumed tokens but produced no usable verdict due to API errors - implement pre-flight checks or circuit breakers for failing endpoints
